name: check_availability
description: The one row of the rights table that governs a title, territory, platform and date, and the clauses that row can be read under. Returns the row; it does not decide the answer.

title_id.description: The slate id, t-NNN. Not the title as written.

territory.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, as the rights table holds it.

date.description: The publication date, YYYY-MM-DD, or an instant for a theatrical release under embargo. It is recorded with the call and is not matched on: the row is found by title, territory and platform, and whether the date falls in the window is read from the row.

found.description: false when the rights table has no row for this title, territory and platform. There is then nothing to publish under.

row.description: The governing row, exactly as the rights table holds it. null when found is false.

clause_candidates.description: The clauses of the licence this row can be read under, from data/clause_index.json. Which one the question turns on is the agent's to say; the tool does not decide it.

source.description: Where the row was read. The deployed runtime reads the DynamoDB table; a run in the CI runner reads the file the table is loaded from, because the table does not exist until the deploy (M01 PR 2).
